A. $-4$ 。
B. $-1$ 。
C. $3$ 。
D. $11$ 。", "answer": "B", "reasoning": "From the given equations, we can form a system of linear equations:
1) $2m - n = 7 \Rightarrow n = 2m - 7$
2) $m + 2n + 6 = 7 \Rightarrow m + 2n = 1$
Substitute $n = 2m - 7$ into equation 2: $m + 2(2m - 7) = 1 \Rightarrow m + 4m - 14 = 1 \Rightarrow 5m = 15 \Rightarrow m = 3$.
Then, $n = 2(3) - 7 = 6 - 7 = -1$."}
